query: At about what age do adults normally begin to lose bone mass?
query_sw: Kwa kawaida watu wazima huanza kupoteza misi ya mfupa katika umri gani?
passage_injected: In adults, this occurs Kwa kawaida watu wazima huanza kupoteza misi ya mfupa katika umri gani? at a rate of about 10% each year. This is a natural process to ensure maintenance of normal bone mass as a person ages. Normal bone mass indicates healthy bones that are free of problems such as osteoporosis. The remodeling cycle usually starts when injury or mechanical stresses occur in bones.
